items.desc: Excavation for foundations (all types, incl. dewatering)
Backfilling with approved granular material, compacted in layers
Anti-termite treatment below pile caps and footings
Select granular backfill behind abutments — compacted (both ends)
Concrete M30 — deck slab (incl. diaphragms, approach parapets, haunches)
Formwork curved soffit — deck slab (incl. staging where height > 5m)
Reinforcement Fe500D — deck slab
Concrete M30 — NONE longitudinal girders
Formwork — girder webs and flanges (complex curved)
Reinforcement Fe500D — girders
Bituminous concrete (BC) wearing coat 65mm
Tack coat bitumen emulsion RS-1 @ 0.25 kg/sqm (between DBM and BC)
Modified bituminous membrane waterproofing on deck (2-layer system)
Elastomeric bearing None×Nonemm supply + install (4 nos)
Compression seal joint ±10mm (A1-End)
RCC parapet / New Jersey barrier — both sides of bridge
RCC deck drainage scupper 150mm dia — 4 nos (@6m c/c both sides)
CI downpipe 150mm dia per metre run (avg 4m drop each)
Thermoplastic road marking — lane markings both carriageways
Boulder launching apron — graded at piers and abutments
Stone pitching 450mm thick on river banks (both sides 10m from bridge)
CC pitching M15 100mm on filter as slope revetment
Concrete cube testing (3 cubes per set, 1 set per 5 CUM)
Reinforcement bar tensile + bend tests (1 per 10 MT)
Survey and setting out — total station, DGPS, monitoring
Proof load test on completed bridge (IRC:6-2017)
